protocol: DNA OS Unified AI Runtime v1
note: Per-file lock ledger. Supersedes registry/WORK_LOCK.json (which could only represent one worker at a time) — multiple agents may hold locks simultaneously as long as they lock different files. Lock only the files you are actively modifying, never the whole project. To acquire: append an entry to locks[]. To release: remove your entry entirely (do not just mark it idle — a stale entry blocks nobody but confuses the next reader).
rule: Never edit a file that has an active lock entry held by a different agent_id/session_id. Never overwrite another agent's work.
